speaker: alice
text: Right, first up, scientists have created a special type of algae that works like a magnet for microscopic plastic pollution in our waterways. These clever little organisms produce limonene - that's the orange-scented oil - which helps them bind to those nasty water-repelling microplastics.

speaker: charlie
text: That's absolutely brilliant! And speaking of brilliant, tandem solar cells made from perovskite and silicon have smashed efficiency records, hitting over 34% power conversion. That's a massive jump from the usual 24% we get from commercial panels.

speaker: alice
text: What that means for us Queenslanders is more energy per square metre, making solar viable even on smaller rooftops and moving vehicles. Perfect timing with our sunny skies and that warm autumn weather we're having!
